_comment: Confusion matrices from the single-split baseline run described in
docs/RESULTS.md. Rows are the true class, columns the predicted class, in the
order [benign, malignant]. The decision rule was argmax over the two output
units; no probability scores were retained from this run, which is why the
baseline table carries no ROC-AUC and why the benchmark harness now persists

protocol.split: dataset's own Training/Testing directories, no cross-validation

_comment: Published accuracies from Surendren & Sumitha, ICDICI 2024 (DOI
10.1109/ICDICI62993.2024.10810998), listed as context only. They come from a
different split of a larger dataset (2,367 train / 660 test) under an
unstated protocol, so they are not directly comparable to the numbers above.
reference_paper.citation: Surendren D. and Sumitha J., ICDICI 2024, pp. 1254-1258
